levels.surface: أبو أحمد هاني بن محمد بن محمود العبدي

notes: «بِإِسْنادِهِ - رَفَعَهُ - إِلى» is the gap «بإسناده يرفعه إلى» (rule 8): an unnamed link in its place, between Muhammad b. Mahmud and Musa.
«محمد بن محمود» stands twice in the text (inside «هانِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَحْمُودٍ»); the chain's own link is occurrence 2.
Musa b. Ja'far is named inside the chain after «إلى»: narrator, and the saying is his own first-person account of his meeting with al-Rashid. «عليه السلام» is an honorific.
